notes.title: October Patch Incoming, Plus Decks Rotation
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we've got a couple of exciting things coming up! First off, we are going to be doing a soft rank reset on October 1st, starting a new ranking season! The new season will feature a minor balance patch designed to address some interactions in the game that feel broken or unfair. We are also rolling out new card tech into the client that will allow for the direct summoning of random units! Below are the patch notes for the upcoming changes:


- ONE-EYED MADDY: Ability upgraded to INITIATIVE: Summon a random mage. (Originally draw a random mage).

- CALL TO WAR: Changed to 2g: Summon a random unit costing (3) or less. (Originally draw 2 random units)

--- OTHER BALANCE CHANGES ---

- DRAGON'S HOARD: This card will be redesigned due to continued potential for abuse by gold generating cards. It is now 3g: Add a random unit costing (3) or less and a random spell costing (2) or less to your hand, and Gain 1 gold.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10103959/117ef7bd457d788786abcba2945affeb9e1d2f18.jpg[/img]

- WOETEN: LAST WILL effect will be removed. We feel that the stats and combos on this card make it strong enough on its own, and players generally don't like having to face the same card over and over.

- FENRIR: Attack will be reduced to 5.

- DEFLECTING SHIELD: Cost will increase to 5g.

- RALLY THE TOWN: Because of the new summon tech, peasants created by Rally the Town will also summon their rat companions. To account for this, the number of peasants summoned will be reduced to 2.

We will also be rotating a few new decks into the store tonight. We hope everyone is looking forward to the new patch and ranking season!

notes.title: King Crab Hotfix
notes.notes:
Later this evening we will be deploying a quick followup to the 3.2 patch, mostly to give the King Crab a more distinct role. We feel this card is really powerful in basically any deck using pirates, and could use a more interesting design. We will be setting recently changed status on this and any other cards we adjust, so if the King Crab no longer fits in your deck you can exchange him for a different legendary!

- KING CRAB: Stats changed to 7/4 and is now classified as a MONSTER.

- ICE BLAST: Cost increased to 5g.

notes.title: Store Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10103959/2b4d275483cf14767b93746a9deb6954f728b1c6.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, so we found out that nobody liked the new Shop! In retrospect, offering card bundles at 7 packs and 18 packs was probably silly. Those are silly numbers! So we just pushed a big update, and it's got a few things. First, there are NEW DECKS! That's right 3 new pre-constructed decks, and this time they come with castles too! Second, we've adjusted the pack tiers to use PRETTY NUMBERS. Would you like to buy 10 packs? Maybe 25? Those are pretty numbers, wow! To reduce clutter, we also pulled the Wild Packs from the store for now and are just selling Dragon and Monster packs, and the single Dragon or Monster pack can be bought for CP. Cool! There might be a few other surprises in there too. Take a look!

notes.title: Patch Notes! July 28th
notes.notes:
--- COLLECTION ---

- CP cards packs have been added to the store! You can now buy normal Cards Packs in the shop for 1000 CP! Quests now award card points only to facilitate this change, and the CP/SP exchange rate had to be modified to balance the economy with this addition.

- Tournament rewards have been GREATLY improved! You can now earn 1 card pack guaranteed, in addition to scaling bonus rewards based on win count. Losses allowed is reduced to 2, and tournament price increased to 1500 CP. Overall tournament should be much more rewarding.


--- CARDS ---

SHADOW SLIP: The gold savings on this card scale in a way we did not anticipate, and is simply too potent with certain combos. The cost reduction benefit has been reduced from 3 to 1. Cost reduced to 2.

SUSHI SHACK: Persistent move speed is much stronger than we anticipated in this format and is exceptionally frustrating for enemy players, especially for the reach it gives to freshly played units. We've redesigned this card to be a little more reasonable: 3g, at the start of your turn give a random friendly unit +1 movement. 

SOUTHPORT CANNONEER: The stats of this card are misaligned, and slipped through our QA process during beta. It has been corrected: movement reduced to 2, HP reduced to 5.

KNOCKOUT: Attack limitation reduced to 3 to better match its intent as an early-game card.

ETERNAL JUDGEMENT: No longer draws a card. With the reduced HP format, this card is powerful enough already without the card draw.

SUIT OF ARMOR: HP reduced to 9.

PIRATE SHIP: Cost increased to 4.

SPECIAL DELIVERY: Cost increased to 5.

RAGNAR THE MARAUDER: Cost reduced to 4g, stats 2/6, now gains +1/+1 with greed.


--- MECHANICS ---

IMMOBILE: Now counts as both an ability AND a status effect, meaning it cannot be removed by transforming the unit.

FLYING: Can now block other creatures with Flying.

BRIDGE TROLL: Fixed so his gold reduction mechanic works at 1g.

notes.title: Minor Faction Update
notes.notes:
Lately we've noticed a lot of legacy players returning to the game and having their decks flagged as invalid due to faction changes made several months ago. With this change, several previously neutral cards such as Barbarian, Craxus, Treant etc were changed from neutral cards to faction cards. We have decided to revert these cards back to their neutral status to avoid deck invalidation and create a smoother experience for the players. Because these cards are being changed to neutral, no deck modifications will be required by any players and we believe the impact on the overall game will feel fair at this point in time.

One other reminder, the next expansion Return to Monster Island is launching on July 21st! It's getting close!

notes.title: Campaigns Update
notes.notes: We wanted to alert players that when the Monster Island expansion is released in late July, campaign mode will be removed from game. We feel this aspect of the game is not living up to our quality standards, and would rather focus exclusively on making multiplayer mode the absolute best it can be. Players will have until the release day in July to finish their existing campaigns and collect their rewards!

notes.title: Deck Building Update
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that with the Monster Island update in July comes an important upgrade to our deck building mechanics. We are going to expand the flexibility and potential synergy of decks with a few key changes: first, decks will contain more cards! Monster Island decks will contain 40 cards each, and allow up to 3 of each card. Secondly, we are dropping all special restrictions on legendary cards: legendaries will be allowed 3 of a kind, and they will be searchable and craftable as well!

Although this change does not release for a few months, we are giving players the opportunity to start preparing for it right now! As of this moment, your card collection will allow you to create and keep up to 3 copies of each card, including legendary cards! This means you can start crafting legendaries right away! Please keep in mind when crafting that some legacy cards will be unavailable for ranked play after the Monster Island expansion, and will furthermore not be available to craft or pull after that release. More on this system is explained in our previous news post.

If you have any questions or want more information, please check our community forum for details! Thank you!

notes.title: Interface Upgrade Patch
notes.notes:
Build #1213 has just been deployed with the following small improvements:

- The visual feedback for drawing cards is now greatly improved; cards fly out of a deck sitting behind the player's castle, and the sound synchronization on the draw has been fixed.

- Players now receive a warning a few turns before their deck will run out of cards.

- What was previously the stalemate mechanic is now called "Deck Burn", and now deals 5 damage directly to the castle and triggers a 50% shorter turn timer.

- Fixed a bug causing faction levels to not update correctly on the deck builder screen without a restart.

- Fixed a bug causing cards to remain large after they are disenchanted on the card collection view.

- Misc other minor bug fixes.

We hope you enjoy the improved deck interface!
